sources: https://www.facebook.com/CurraheeRvCampground/ (login wall; nothing readable without an account, 2026-10-29)
Google Maps place 'Currahee RV and Campground', 1107 Cawthon Rd, Toccoa (4.7 stars, 150 reviews, phone +1 706-779-2340, website = the Facebook page), read 2026-10-29

values.note: CAMPER-REPORTED: RV Life reviewers paid $25 (back-in creek site 15, October 2026), $30 (pull-through 21, September 2026, twice) and $35 (site 5, July 2026); Campendium reviewers $30 in 2024-2025. The park has no website, only a Facebook page.

fees.source: RV Life reviews (camper reports, not the operator): https://campgrounds.rvlife.com/api/reviews/park/251712 (stayed 10/2026 '$25 USD a night', 9/2026 '$30', 7/2026 '$35'), read 2026-10-29

hookups.source: RV Life reviews (camper reports): every 2026 stay lists water yes, sewer yes; 10/2026 '#15 Full hookup on a stream', read 2026-10-29. The stored 50 A rested on directory listings only and no operator page states it, so it is cleared.

sites.source: RV Life reviews (camper reports): 9/2026 'site 21 pull_through ... Level concrete pads', 8/2026 site 22 and 7/2026 site 5 pull-through, read 2026-10-29. The stored count of 38 came from Campendium/Roadtrippers directory text, so it is cleared.

facilities.source: RV Life review, stayed 9/2026 (camper report): 'No laundry on site'; another 9/2026 reviewer: 'No amenities to speak of'. The stored bathhouse rested on directory text only, so showers is cleared. Read 2026-10-29.

season.source: No operator page states a season (Facebook only, unreadable); the stored year-round came from directory text, so it is cleared. Read 2026-10-29.

booking.source: No operator page; reviewers describe an unstaffed office where you call the owners on arrival ('The office is not manned', 'you had to call them', RV Life 9/2026). The stored phone-reservation claim came from directory text, so booking is cleared. Read 2026-10-29.

note: Owner-run park ~10 min from downtown Toccoa near Currahee Mountain. The office is unstaffed; call the owners (number on the Facebook page and Google). Several long-term residents. Back-in sites along a creek have wood decks; the pull-throughs are concrete. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $25-35 a night in July-October 2026 (RV Life reviews); the park has no website, only Facebook (2026-10-29). --Claude
summary: No website (Facebook only, unreadable); presence via Google Maps (4.7 / 150 reviews, phone 706-779-2340 matches). Rate from dated 2026 camper reports: $25-35 (was $30 from Campendium). Water/sewer and pull-throughs camper-reported; directory-only 50 A, site count, showers, season and phone booking cleared; laundry set false ('No laundry on site', 9/2026). Pin within ~150 m of Google's. Note rewritten.
flags: Long-stay character, no posted nightly rate (test 2): an RV Life reviewer writes 'Several long term folks here' (7/2026) and a Campendium reviewer 'A lot of full timers' (2/2025); the old note called sites A-G permanent. The park posts no nightly rate anywhere it controls (Facebook only), so under the long-stay rule's test 2 a camper report can't stand in. Overnighters are clearly sold (2026 stays of one night to two weeks). A human decides.

Waterfront re-audit lead: stored 'not waterfront'. Reviewers describe back-in sites on a creek with decks ('#15 Full hookup on a stream', RV Life 10/2026; 'Our site backed up to a creek, and had a nice deck', Campendium 4/2024).

Price rests on camper reports only ($25-35 in 2026); no gateway within 40 km (GSMNP 109 km); the family has not stayed here. One 8/2026 reviewer reports $40 'with Passport America', which looks mis-entered.
